nodes.label: camera-visible-fluctuation
nodes.purpose: High-frame-rate (>= 50 kfps) FAST-camera acquisitions. Same IDS as the routine camera product in the baseline source, so it is kept apart by lineage rather than by occurrence. Sparse, and disjoint from routine camera: a shot is one regime or the other.

nodes.label: electron-efit
nodes.purpose: Kinetic EFIT derived from Thomson scattering with an assumed Ti/Te ratio.

nodes.label: impa
nodes.purpose: Insertable magnetic probe array. Sparse: only shots whose IMPA product was intentionally produced. Absence means no published IMPA product, nothing more.

nodes.label: kinetic-efit
nodes.purpose: Kinetic EFIT for shots with Thomson scattering and CES/ion-Doppler spectroscopy.

nodes.label: kinetic-efit/neoclassical
nodes.purpose: Neoclassical transport from NEO on the kinetic-EFIT lineage: the bootstrap current and the particle and energy fluxes, plus the identity of the state they were computed from -- not a copy of that state's profiles, which stay in the source that owns them.

nodes.label: main
nodes.purpose: Default source for the VAFT-native pipeline; stores the VAFT EFIT baseline.

nodes.label: main/chease
nodes.purpose: CHEASE-refined equilibrium for the magnetic reconstruction lineage. Holds the refinement alone -- the reconstruction it refines stays in 'main', and composing the two is explicit.

nodes.label: camera_visible
nodes.note: sparse optional diagnostic; an ineligible product is recorded, not raised

nodes.label: camera_visible_fluctuation
nodes.note: high-frame-rate camera lineage; kept out of the baseline camera product

nodes.label: ces
nodes.note: externally uploaded ion diagnostic; absent on most shots

nodes.label: core_profiles
nodes.note: requires thomson; ion channels only when ces is present

nodes.label: eddy
nodes.note: solves against the diagnostics IDS but owns only pf_passive; the product is exactly this projection

nodes.label: electron_efit
nodes.note: thomson without ces; pressure uses the assumed Ti/Te ratio

nodes.label: impa
nodes.note: sparse optional diagnostic; an ineligible product is recorded, not raised

nodes.label: kinetic_efit
nodes.note: thomson with ces; pressure uses the measured ion temperature

nodes.label: neoclassical
nodes.note: opt-in solver product; requires a state that passes vaft.validation.neoclassical.input_readiness

nodes.label: shotlog
nodes.note: operator-logged schedule; a shot absent from the ShotLog is recorded, not raised

nodes.label: soft_x_rays
nodes.note: sparse optional diagnostic; an ineligible product is recorded, not raised

nodes.label: static
nodes.note: machine-era product with no shot; travels inside diagnostics

nodes.label: thomson
nodes.note: externally uploaded profile diagnostic; absent on most shots
